npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: God save you. What news of the parish?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Dia is Muire dhuit! All is quiet enough at the crossroads today, though a drover passing through spoke of hard times and evictions over the county border. Have ye travelled far along the road this fine morning?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his brow with a heavy forearm and gives a hearty laugh.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: How does the harvest look this year?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Sure, 'tis early days yet to speak of the harvest with the seed barely in the furrows, though the plough-irons brought to my anvil are in fine trim. If the soft weather keeps up, we ought to see a grand yield come autumn, buíochas le Dia. Are ye looking to hire on for the spring planting hereabouts?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron taps a finished coulter with his hammer and grins.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Have you seen Father Declan today?

response_lines.speaker: System
response_lines.text: Fr. Declan Tierney is not here.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I haven't laid eyes on Father Declan this morning, mo chara, though he'll likely be up about St. Brigid's Church if ye have business with him. Colm and I have been keeping to the hearth since first light, so he hasn't passed by the forge. Were ye needing him for something pressing?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his brow with a soot-stained hand and chuckles.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: And how is your own family keeping?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Mhuise, we are in grand fettle altogether, with my Maire keeping well at home and young Colm here gaining a stout arm at the anvil every day. A healthy house is a fine blessing in spring. How do your own folk fare?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron chuckles heartily and claps a hand on Colm's shoulder.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Is old Festus the cooper still at his shop by the bridge?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I know no man named Festus in these parts, nor is there a cooper's shop by any bridge in this parish. Ye may have another townland in mind, mo chara. What sort of cask or hoop were ye looking to have mended?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron gives a hearty chuckle and leans his tongs against the anvil.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: How do I get to the abbey in town?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: There is no abbey in these parts, mo chara, only St. Brigid's Church down the way. Ye would have to walk a fair distance out of the parish entirely to come across stones like that. What had ye hoping to find there?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron gives a hearty chuckle and rests a hand on his anvil.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Tell me about your work, but keep it brief.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: 'Tis hot, honest work with fire and iron, from shoeing beasts to sharpening ploughshares for the parish. Between the hearth and the anvil, young Colm and I keep every wheel and blade moving, buíochas le Dia. Have ye ever tried your hand at a blacksmith's hammer?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron rests a broad hand upon the handle of his hammer with a hearty grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: I cannot sleep for worrying. What would you advise?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: A good day of hard labour is the finest cure I know for an uneasy mind, mo chara, for when the body is properly spent, sleep comes swift enough. Either that, or a quiet sup down at Darcy's to talk out the trouble with good company. What heavy thought is keeping your eyes open through the night?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron chuckles softly and rests a heavy hand on the anvil horn.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Do you know Padraig Darcy?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Aye, I know Padraig well—he keeps Darcy's Pub and is as sound a friend as any man in the parish. Many a good evening I've spent by his hearth sharing a sup and a laugh after a hard turn at the anvil, mo chara. Were ye thinking of heading down his way today?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans on the anvil with a broad grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: What can you tell me of Ballyglass Castle?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I know of no castle by that name in these parts, mo chara, nor any great stone keep hereabouts. If 'tis an old stronghold ye seek, ye must have in mind somewhere far beyond our parish bounds. What brought that name to your ear?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his brow with the back of his arm and chuckles.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: I heard Cormac Duffy was at the mill. Is that true?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Cormac is our miller and keeps the place, though I cannot vouch for his exact whereabouts this morning as I haven't left the hearth. He rarely strays far from the wheel once the water is running, buíochas le Dia. Have ye some grain ye need ground?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron chuckles and wipes his brow with a leather-gloved forearm.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Thank you. I should let you return to your work.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Aye, the fire waits for no man, but 'twas grand chatting with ye! Slán leat, and may your day go well.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron gives a hearty nod and picks up his heavy tongs.*
